item.title: Tranmere Rovers 2-0 Crawley Town: Match Report
item.description: Tranmere Rovers won 2-0 at home to Crawley Town thanks to home debutant Zech Obiero’s first goal for the Club and striker Joe Ironside’s penalty. In the sixth minute, Obiero’s effort was saved, and Sam Finley scored the rebound; the goal was disallowed for offside, but it wasn’t a momentum-killer. Six minutes later, however, Obiero broke into the box and fired into the roof of the net, giving Rovers the lead with his first goal. item.title: PIONEERING RESEARCH STUDY TO IMPROVE CARE OF HEARTBURN AND TACKLE CANCER GOES LIVE IN WIRRAL
item.description: Heartburn Health, a national research programme to find ways to improve care for people with heartburn, indigestion or acid reflux has launched in the Wirral and is looking for volunteers with these symptoms, aged 55-79 to take part. Supported by the NHS and Cancer Research UK, Heartburn Health is creating a community of at least 120,000 people who experience heartburn, indigestion or acid reflux.
